_about: Executive-officer changes at public companies, taken from SEC 8-K Item 5.02 filings dated 2026-10-12 to 2026-11-20. Candidates came from EDGAR full-text search (efts.sec.gov, forms=8-K, items incl. 5.02, mentioning CEO/CFO/General Counsel), shortlisted to well-known issuers and credit names, then each filing was read on 2026-11-24. 'quote' is a short verbatim phrase from the filing. EDGAR full-text search covered filings through 2026-11-22, so a change announced on 2026-11-23/24 would be missed: re-check before each run.

events.query: who's running goodyear now? heard the CEO left
events.gold_answer: Roger Wood, a Goodyear director, is interim CEO. Mark Stewart stepped down as CEO, president and director effective immediately (8-K filed Nov 9, 2026).
events.quote: Mark Stewart will step down as chief executive officer and president
events.notes: Saying Mark Stewart is CEO is the stale answer: INCORRECT. The same release names Jerome Rouquet CFO from Dec 1, 2026 (not required).

events.query: home depot CEO change — who's the new CEO and when does it start
events.gold_answer: Richard (Ric) McPhail, previously EVP and CFO, became CEO effective Nov 23, 2026. Edward (Ted) Decker stepped down as President and CEO and remains Board Chair; Ann-Marie Campbell becomes President and COO and Jordan Broggi EVP and CFO.
events.quote: Mr. Decker will step down as President and CEO of the Company, effective as of the Effective Date
events.notes: 8-K filed Nov 17, 2026. Saying Decker is still CEO is stale: INCORRECT.

events.query: has HP named a permanent CEO yet?
events.gold_answer: Yes. HP appointed Emma Walmsley CEO effective Jan 4, 2027. Interim CEO Bruce Broussard serves until Jan 3, 2027 and then becomes Board Chair (8-K filed Nov 4, 2026).
events.quote: appointed Emma Walmsley as Chief Executive Officer of the Company, effective as of January 4, 2027
events.notes: Saying no permanent CEO has been named is stale: INCORRECT.

events.query: sirius xm CEO succession — who replaces witz and when
events.gold_answer: Anjali Sud (a Sirius XM director and Tubi CEO) succeeds Jennifer Witz as CEO effective Jan 1, 2027; Witz steps down as CEO and director at the end of Dec 31, 2026 (8-K filed Nov 9, 2026).
events.quote: Ms. Sud succeeds Jennifer C. Witz, who is stepping down from her role as the Company's Chief Executive Officer
events.notes: (none)

events.query: who's replacing john idol at capri
events.gold_answer: Justin Boxford was named CEO of Capri Holdings effective Jan 4, 2027 and joins the board; John D. Idol retires as Chairman and CEO, and Robin Freestone becomes Independent Chairman (announced Nov 11, 2026).
events.quote: Justin Boxford has been named Chief Executive Officer of Capri Holdings
events.notes: (none)

events.query: clear channel outdoor — who's CEO now that the mubadala deal closed
events.gold_answer: Wade Davis became CEO and Executive Chairman when Mubadala Capital completed its acquisition (Oct 14, 2026), succeeding Scott Wells, who stepped down as CEO and director and will advise the company.
events.quote: Wade Davis has become Chief Executive Officer of the Company, succeeding Scott Wells
events.notes: Scott Wells as current CEO is stale: INCORRECT.

events.query: bausch + lomb CEO situation?
events.gold_answer: Brent Saunders departed as CEO and director effective Oct 12, 2026, and Chairman Thomas J. Appio was appointed interim CEO.
events.quote: Thomas J. Appio, who is currently Chairman of the Board, was appointed to serve as the interim Chief Executive Officer
events.notes: Saunders as current CEO is stale: INCORRECT. Re-check for a permanent appointment before each run.

events.query: who's taking over as JPMorgan CFO from Barnum, and when
events.gold_answer: Bregje de Best, CFO of the Commercial & Investment Bank, will succeed Jeremy Barnum as CFO following first-quarter 2027 financial reporting; Barnum becomes a Vice Chairman (announced Nov 17, 2026).
events.quote: Bregje de Best will succeed Jeremy Barnum as Chief Financial Officer following first-quarter 2027 financial reporting
events.notes: (none)

events.company: The PNC Financial Services Group, Inc.
events.query: PNC new CFO and start date
events.gold_answer: Alexander E.C. (Alex) Overstrom becomes CFO on March 1, 2027, succeeding Robert Q. (Rob) Reilly, who becomes Executive Vice Chairman (announced Nov 5, 2026).
events.quote: Overstrom will officially assume the CFO role March 1, 2027
events.notes: (none)

events.query: paypal CFO change?
events.gold_answer: Yes. Claire Bramley, former CFO of Xero, is appointed EVP and CFO effective Feb 3, 2027, succeeding Jamie Miller, who ceases to be EVP, Chief Financial and Operating Officer on Feb 2, 2027 (8-K filed Nov 20, 2026).
events.quote: will cease to serve as the Executive Vice President, Chief Financial and Operating Officer
events.notes: Freshest row: filed Nov 20, 2026.

events.query: has fedex named a permanent CFO
events.gold_answer: Yes. Jamere Jackson, CFO of AutoZone, becomes FedEx EVP and CFO effective Nov 30, 2026, succeeding Claude F. Russ, interim CFO since June 1, 2026 (8-K filed Oct 26, 2026).
events.quote: Mr. Jackson succeeds Claude F. Russ, who has served as the Company's Interim Chief Financial Officer since June 1, 2026
events.notes: Saying FedEx only has an interim CFO with no permanent pick is stale: INCORRECT.

events.query: is pfizer's CFO still interim?
events.gold_answer: No. Pfizer's board appointed Cecile Guegan, who had been interim CFO, as permanent Chief Financial Officer and Executive Vice President effective Nov 1, 2026.
required_facts: now permanent CFO (no longer interim), effective Nov 1, 2026
events.quote: has unanimously appointed Cecile Guegan as Chief Financial Officer and Executive Vice President
events.notes: Stale trap: answering that Guegan is still interim is INCORRECT.

events.query: albertsons CFO — still interim or did they hire someone
events.gold_answer: They hired Andrew Murray as EVP and CFO effective Jan 17, 2027. Until then interim CFO Cody Perdue continues, then returns to SVP, Treasury, Investor Relations and Risk (announced Nov 10, 2026).
events.quote: announced the appointment of Andrew Murray as Executive Vice President, Chief Financial Officer effective January 17, 2027
events.notes: (none)

events.query: Strategy (MSTR) CFO change — what happened
events.gold_answer: CFO Andrew Kang resigned effective Nov 5, 2026. Phong Le serves as principal financial officer through Dec 31, 2026, and EVP of Operations Reza Virasteh becomes EVP and CFO effective Jan 1, 2027 (8-K filed Oct 29, 2026).
events.quote: will assume the role of Executive Vice President & Chief Financial Officer
events.notes: Ambiguous name: Strategy Inc (formerly MicroStrategy, ticker MSTR). An answer about an unrelated company called Strategy is INCORRECT.

events.query: super micro new CFO?
events.gold_answer: Mark Long was appointed CFO effective immediately on Oct 14, 2026, replacing David Weigand.
events.quote: appointed Mark Long as Chief Financial Officer of the Company, effective immediately
events.notes: Weigand as current CFO is stale: INCORRECT.

events.query: is transunion's CFO leaving?
events.gold_answer: Yes. CFO Todd M. Cello is resigning effective Dec 31, 2026, and David Gilbert is appointed Interim CFO effective Jan 1, 2027 (8-K filed Nov 5, 2026).
required_facts: David Gilbert interim CFO from Jan 1, 2027
events.quote: appointed David Gilbert as the Interim Chief Financial Officer
events.notes: (none)

events.query: who's sempra's CFO now
events.gold_answer: Justin C. Bird became EVP and CFO effective Nov 13, 2026, succeeding Karen L. Sedgwick, who became CEO of Southern California Gas Company (8-K filed Nov 12, 2026; Bird's appointment was first announced July 9, 2026).
events.quote: Mr. Bird will assume the Chief Financial Officer role from Karen L. Sedgwick
events.notes: Stale trap: Karen Sedgwick as current CFO is INCORRECT (she handed over on Nov 13, 2026).

events.query: albertsons general counsel — who should our legal team be dealing with now
events.gold_answer: Tom Moriarty stepped down as General Counsel and Corporate Secretary effective Nov 18, 2026 (advising through Feb 27, 2027). Deputy General Counsel Elena Dietrich is interim General Counsel and Corporate Secretary while a permanent successor is sought.
required_facts: Elena Dietrich is interim General Counsel
events.quote: will serve as interim General Counsel and Corporate Secretary
events.notes: Moriarty as current GC is stale: INCORRECT.

events.query: chemours new general counsel and when they start
events.gold_answer: Amy M. Rocklin succeeds the retiring Kristine M. Wellman as SVP, General Counsel & Corporate Secretary effective Jan 4, 2027; Wellman stays as SVP, Senior Counsel until May 7, 2027 (8-K filed Nov 18, 2026).
events.quote: the Company has selected Amy M. Rocklin to succeed Ms. Wellman
events.notes: (none)

events.query: who's replacing jennifer hamann as union pacific CFO
events.gold_answer: No successor has been named. Union Pacific said on Oct 16, 2026 that EVP and CFO Jennifer Hamann will retire in early 2027 and that succession plans will be announced later; no later 8-K naming a successor was found through Nov 22, 2026.
events.quote: Executive Vice President and Chief Financial Officer Jennifer Hamann will retire in early 2027
events.notes: Premise trap: naming a successor is INCORRECT unless Union Pacific has actually announced one; re-check EDGAR and UP's newsroom before each run and update the gold if a successor is named.
